findings.title: Make REGIONS immutable.
findings.rationale:
public static final does not make the list immutable. Arrays.asList allows callers to replace elements with set, which can alter shared deployment defaults globally.

Wrap the list with Collections.unmodifiableList(...) before exposing it.

Proposed fix

+import java.util.Collections; import java.util.List; @@ -    public static final List<String> REGIONS = Arrays.asList("us-east-1", "eu-west-1"); +    public static final List<String> REGIONS = +            Collections.unmodifiableList(Arrays.asList("us-east-1", "eu-west-1"));
